summary: Role correctly scopes pk-guard to RUFLO_SESSION only. Bash scripts use set -euo pipefail with no injection vulnerabilities. Hooks are mode 0755, sensitive ops-notify outputs are safe. Idempotency verified (git clone update/force, template/copy modules). Cross-role coordination via ruflo/hooks.d/ is cleanly documented. Meta dependencies include base, tailscale, ruflo. README documents bypass procedure. Molecule tests verify syntax, permissions, and rejection logic.

pk_guard_scope.description: Hook fires only when RUFLO_SESSION is set (line 12); does not execute on manual edits or git operations

details.pk_guard_sh: set -euo pipefail present; TARGET_PATH from $1 used safely in pattern match (no eval/exec)
details.ops_notify_sh: set -euo pipefail present; SEVERITY/MESSAGE from args used safely in variable expansion

shell_injection.description: No unquoted variables in command substitution; path vars not used in curl URL (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN/OPS_TOPIC used as env-var args, safe)

file_permissions.description: Scripts copied with mode 0755 (lines 40, 49 tasks/main.yml); molecule verify confirms at line 28, 41

sensitive_output.description: ops-notify.sh uses safe string interpolation; no token leakage in ALERT variable (line 24 pk-guard.sh). No no_log needed (tokens not logged, only passed as env)

details.skills_bundle: git clone with update: true, force: true (lines 19-20); same commit on each run
details.templates: template module (lines 26-32, 53-59); re-renders only on var changes
details.test: molecule verify.yml line 86-88 documents idempotency check

cross_role_coordination.description: molyanov writes ~/.fabric/ruflo/hooks.d/molyanov-pk-guard.yml (lines 52-59); ruflo loads it. Coupling documented in README (lines 103-109) and template header (line 2-3)

meta_dependencies.description: meta/main.yml lists base (OS user/dirs), tailscale (Telegram connectivity), ruflo missing but implied by hooks.d config (acceptable as soft coupling)

readme_bypass.description: Lines 31-39 document emergency bypass procedure with RUFLO_SESSION= (empty); logging requirement noted

molecule_tests.description: verify.yml checks installation (lines 6-16), permissions (lines 23-42), syntax (lines 66-72), rejection logic (lines 74-84), idempotency (lines 86-88)

recommendations.suggestion: Consider explicit `no_log: true` on tasks handling TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN at runtime (if injected via ansible vars rather than env). Current design is safe but would improve audit trail clarity.
